author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: A scalar Boolean parity lift sharpens the retained incidence-degree cutoff from k(a+2p-2) to k(a+p-1), replacing the p-coefficient truncated algebra by Z/2^p Z. A realizable family of distinct sparse nonlinear equations still has exp(Omega(n log log n)) unit incidence coefficients, precluding smaller wire order from zero-coefficient pruning in a one-monomial-per-code encoding. The full SAT time envelope and alpha are unchanged.

A changed aggregate representation or another mechanism giving a uniform asymptotic improvement
Complete realizable all-input cost for any proposed successor; no new SAT time bound is established
